title: Inline code vanishes from text output
prompts:
Bug report: inline code spans disappear wherever mdlite turns inline content into plain text.

- `mdlite --text` and `renderText('Run `npm test` now')` drop the code: the output reads `Run  now`.
- A table of contents built from `# The `init` command` lists the heading as `The  command` and links to `#the-command`, and heading ids come out the same way.

Expected: the text of a code span is kept exactly as written, including runs of spaces inside the span (`a `x  y` b` gives `a x  y b`), in the plain-text output, in the table-of-contents entries and in heading ids and anchors (ids keep their usual slug rules, so `The `init` command` gives `the-init-command`). Find the cause and fix it at its source, then make sure nothing else was working around it. Add tests and run the whole suite.
notes: P3 cross-module bug. The shared text-extraction helper (src/parser/utils.js plainText) drops code nodes; the symptom shows in the plain-text renderer, the TOC plugin and heading ids. Two callers (src/renderer/text.js and src/plugins/toc.js) squeeze double spaces, a workaround for the dropped span, so a fix at the helper alone still fails the hidden space-preservation tests. Three visible tests fail in the start state (they pass once the helper is fixed). The reference reverts all three files to the original.
